title: REAPER MCP server
summary: Guarded MCP control of the REAPER DAW through a local Lua bridge: projects, tracks, MIDI, FX and patch state, rendering. The action surface used by the Bouch audio workbenches. Tools are exposed in selectable profiles; enumerate the live server rather than trusting a count. Local stdio server, not a remote service.

source.note: Third-party upstream (published on PyPI as danishaft-reaper-mcp). Bouch extensions used by the audio workbench (e.g. CLAP patch state, DecentSampler loading, track channel count) are unpublished local commits on top of upstream.

native.note: No server.json exists and the server is not listed in the MCP Registry.
